purpose: Held-out check of the app's reference-term leak scan. Each probe is a student-safe sentence an agent might write for a fixture; `leak` is a human judgement (does it reveal or hint at something the team has not established?). Written before measuring; not used to tune the scan.

amber-falcon: Initial access (phishing email, macro on WS03)
Lateral movement (svc_backup logon + PowerShell on FS01)
They documented the FS01 activity and hypothesised the email and credential dumping on WS03, but missed the download from 203.0.113.50 and the stage.zip exfiltration.
cobalt-lynx: The team found the new IAM user but missed the leaked ci-deployer key in the public repository, the discovery calls and the copy of lynx-payroll-data to an external account. CloudTrail being stopped was only a hypothesis.
